name: Azeroth Companion
title: Blizzard Character Intelligence & Gear Comparison
features: Introduced Character Intelligence, a separate browser-based research studio for public World of Warcraft Retail characters.
Compare two characters by region, realm and name with Blizzard-reported character profiles and equipped item information.
Added equipment slot comparisons, item IDs, item-level differences and JSON snapshot exports for personal research.
Preserved the full Azeroth Companion v7.9.2 Player Handbook, PC and mobile tutorials, saved progress and existing studio features.
Retained the standalone Addon Nexus v8.0 preview and unchanged private Battle.net authentication Worker.
New public character comparisons rely on Blizzard API availability and require real-player acceptance testing; item levels alone do not determine upgrade value.
